answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock blocks fake identities. Each agent posts a $30 bond, locked 20 epochs, released only after building a fingerprint of timing and task mix. Auditors scan the mesa of registrations for identical fingerprints, like telling yarrow from saffron by leaf and scent, and slash clones. Making 1,000 fakes costs $30,000 plus 20,000 epochs of work, against a $3,000 share. One honest agent pays one bond and keeps undiluted rewards.
